analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported a strong H1 FY27 financial performance with consolidated income of INR135.57 crores, marking a 79.91% year-on-year growth. EBITDA reached INR23.62 crores with an EBITDA margin of 17.42%, and PAT grew by 45.09% to INR13.65 crores. Management highlighted robust order inflows during the period, securing 11 orders worth INR209.24 crores and bringing the total order book to over INR565.80 crores. The company is experiencing input cost pressures from CRGO steel and transformer oil, but approximately 70% to 75% of its order book is covered by price variation clauses. Management expects full-year revenue for FY27 to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores and anticipates PAT margins to be maintained in the range of 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management expects full-year FY27 revenue to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: This year, we believe -- we trust we should fetch revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects the order book to be maintained between INR600 crores and INR800 crores by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: With that, I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins to be maintained between 9% to 12% based on the current order book.
guidance.quote: And based on the order book, the margin can be maintained between -- the PAT margin can be maintained between 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management expects peak revenue of INR550 crores to INR600 crores next year.
guidance.quote: Yes, up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores will be the peak revenue.

guidance.claim: PAT margins are expected to be maintained between 9% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So for FY27, we can expect between INR250 crores to INR300 crores top line. And the PAT margin will be around, we believe it will be around 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Year-on-year revenue growth is projected at a minimum of 30%.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment is currently very good, driven by Union and State Government expansion of the transmission network.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes. Actually, now the demand environment is very good and the sector is also very good. Since the Union Government and the State Governments showing much interest in expanding the transmission network, the demand is very high.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that market information indicates good demand for the power sector for the next 8 to 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As per market information, next 8 to 10 years, there will be good demand for this power sector.

demand_outlook.claim: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of the order book and continued demand across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Business momentum remains encouraging as the company continues to progress in line with annual targets.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand for transformers is very high and expected to sustain for at least 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain.

demand_outlook.claim: Global and domestic demand conditions for transformers are described as good and very good.
demand_outlook.quote: And not only in India, but overall global -- across globe, the demand is good. Demand is very good.

demand_outlook.claim: Order inflows remained strong during the quarter with 10 orders secured.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q1 FY27, our total income stood at INR48.31 crores, registering growth of 37.33 % year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that next year they have to think and plan about capacity expansion or capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Next year, we have to think and plan about that.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: Total manufacturing capacity expanded to 9,000 MVA.
The new Kannur manufacturing facility became operational during the previous quarter, expanding capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA.
capex_expansion.quote: The facility has strengthened our overall manufacturing capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA with capabilities extending up to 200 MVA, 220 kV.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming tank manufacturing facility capex is estimated around INR20 crores to INR22 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.
margins_costs.quote: During the period, we have seen pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered under price variation clauses.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, around 70% to 75% of our order book is covered under price variation clauses, which provides a degree of protection against volatility in key raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that higher overheads and skilled manpower requirements for power transformers absorb the margin differential versus distribution transformers.
margins_costs.quote: Actually, for power transformers, the margin is slightly higher than the distribution transformer. But at the same time, it is absorbed by the overheads. So, it needs skilled manpower, so we have to deploy experienced people. So, this 0.5% or 1% margin is absorbed by the -- so this margin will maintain and it will sustain.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed pressure during H1 FY27 primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs across key raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered by price variation clauses, providing protection against significant movements in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 17.42% and net profit margin was 10.07%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 17.42%, while Net Profit margin was 10.07% during the period.

margins_costs.claim: Around 80% to 85% of held orders are covered with price variation clauses to pass on raw material price rises.
margins_costs.quote: Almost 80%, 85% order which we are holding is covered with price variation clause. So whatever the price rise will be passed on to the buyer.

orders_capacity.claim: Supreme Power secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores with execution timelines ranging between 7 and 17 months in H1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: During H1 FY27, we secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores, with execution timelines ranging between 7 months and 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores, providing strong execution visibility for the coming periods.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the total order book of INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, power transformer is around 75% to 78%, and inverter duty transformers are around 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, that is less than INR95 crores. And power transformer is around INR440 crores that comes around 78% -- 75% to 78%. And inverter duty transformers is around INR30 crores, that comes 5% of the total order book.

orders_capacity.claim: Expected revenue from the new plant for the year is INR200 crores to INR250 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: From the new plant, we are expecting INR200 crores to INR250 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr in the first half.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The total order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Government orders represent approximately 30.10% and non-government orders represent approximately 69.9% of the order book.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of customer mix, government orders stand at INR177.6 crores, representing approximately 30.10% of the total order book, while nongovernment orders stands at INR412.46 crores, represent approximately 69.9%.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute the largest share of the order book at 76.91%.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization at the new plant is between 20% and 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, yes. The new plant, our capacity is almost 20% to 25% utilization as of now. We are utilizing 20% to 25%.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that private customers provide advance payments, and repeat customers receive credit for 45 to 60 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Private, some customers, we are getting advance. Most of the customers we get 10% to 30% advance. And before dispatch, we use to get 90% and balance 5% to 10% will be after commissioning. And for repeat customers, we used to give credit for 45 days to 60 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Government payments are received within 60 to 90 days.
capital_allocation.quote: From the government, we get payments in 60 to 90 days.

capital_allocation.claim: There is no equity dilution requirement for the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that price movements in CRGO steel and transformer oil can impact margins when there is a timing difference.
risks_headwinds.quote: These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues caused raw material price fluctuations during the period.
risks_headwinds.quote: And though there was a geopolitical issues were there due to that, the price rise of the raw materials are being absorbed because of this price variation clause, which we get from our buyers.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve utilization of almost 80% for the new facility next year.
management_commitments.quote: And next year, almost 80%, I think we should utilize.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they believe they should get the PGCIL approval within a year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this year, within a year, we should -- we believe we should get the PGCIL approval.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to complete the tank manufacturing facility construction before March.
management_commitments.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to migrate to the main board at an appropriate time.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, we have a plan. In an appropriate time, we will definitely come into the main board.

management_commitments.claim: Main board migration window is expected to open after December.
management_commitments.quote: Main board, I think will be -- the window will be open after December.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
